title: Hand the Marker Back | Jocko Willink on Leadership
hook: A fictional team leader crosses out every proposed idea while teammates stop contributing.
action: After a continuous authentic statement about giving ownership, the leader hands the marker back and steps aside.
payoff: The colleague draws a new connected idea on the same board while the leader listens.
narration:
Imagine your team brings you a plan. You cross out every idea, then wonder why nobody speaks up.

Agree on the goal and the deadline, and hand the marker back. Let them build the next version.
narration_status: Existing recorded original commentary retained unchanged; no new script or synthesis for metadata preparation.
authentic_quote: A lot of taking ownership is actually giving ownership, giving ownership to the people below you in the chain of command so that they can take ownership.
authentic_quote_context: Giving teammates control of planning; complete continuous statement, with no fabricated sentence or imitation.
